Ingen runtimekobling, ny dokumentport eller nytt kanonisk bevis er opprettet. Plassering og eventuell senere integrasjon må bestemmes separat.
Ingen av tekstene fastslår utenomjordisk kontakt, art, en felles årsak eller forbindelse til STATION 01, C, 1947 eller invasjonen.
[REDACTED] er en uttrykkelig plassholder for mørk sladding av navn og adresser. Ingen observasjon eller kritisk ledetråd skal skjules.
Uttrykket kan bruke maskinskrift, kommunal kopipraksis, gult avispapir, veterinærfeltark og sjablongkopi. Ingen virkelige institusjonssegl, føderale klassifikasjoner eller ekte forelesermerker.

COUNTY INQUIRIES / RELEASED COPY

LIGHT REPORTS REMAIN UNRESOLVED

Witness A name: [REDACTED]
Address: [REDACTED]

assets.title: Clocks disagree after late return
assets.text:
PECOS VALLEY SENTINEL
NOVEMBER 9, 1974

CLOCKS DISAGREE AFTER LATE RETURN

A local motorist arrived home long after his family expected him, saying he remembered an ordinary drive and no prolonged stop. His dashboard clock had stopped. The kitchen clock, according to his wife, had been reset that afternoon.

No departure time was written down. The driver declined to have his name printed. No collision or injury was reported, and the route has not been independently checked.

Neighbors have offered explanations ranging from a wrong turn to sleep beside the road. None was confirmed. The Sentinel cannot establish a missing interval from the clocks described.
key_checks: November 9, 1974; an original fictional Pecos Valley Sentinel article, distinct from E15 and the 1985 cuttings.
The dashboard clock stopped and the kitchen clock was reset; no reliable departure time or measured missing interval.
A late return is reported, without confirmed abduction, injury or cause.
No C, eight-mile crossing, 1947 identity, invasion reference or new main-route clue.
assets.intended_use_nb: Gammelt frivillig avisutklipp om tapt tidsfølelse, med motstridende klokker og åpent hendelsesforløp.
assets.notes_nb: Nyskrevet fiktiv avisartikkel. Den beskrevne bilisten er ikke en eksisterende figur, og artikkelen gir ikke målt tidsbortfall.

assets.title: Field examination / cause undetermined
assets.text:
VETERINARY FIELD EXAMINATION
3 JUN 1982 / UNSIGNED FIELD COPY

SUBJECT: ADULT HEREFORD COW, FOUND DEAD
Owner / ranch / ear tag: NOT RECORDED

EXTERNAL OBSERVATIONS
One circular, dry area of missing hair and hide on the upper flank. No fresh blood observed at that site. Photograph made before the carcass was moved. Exposure and scale were not entered on the print.

LIMITS
A complete necropsy was not performed. This sheet does not establish the time or cause of death. The photograph records an external appearance; it does not identify what produced it.

CAUSE OF DEATH: UNDETERMINED.
Further examination required. Retain the original print with this sheet.
key_checks: June 3, 1982; unsigned field examination of a dead adult Hereford cow.
Owner, ranch and ear tag are NOT RECORDED; do not invent ALDERETE, tag 25, or another identification.
If illustrated, show one circular dry flank area with restrained non-bloody forensic appearance; no fresh blood or exposed organs.
CAUSE OF DEATH: UNDETERMINED remains legible; no completed necropsy or confirmed cause.
A photograph is not evidence of a species, perpetrator or extraterrestrial origin.
assets.intended_use_nb: Frivillig eldre veterinærark med et nøkternt feltfotografi, til senere miljø- eller arkivbruk.

assets.title: Keep watch. Keep notes.
assets.text:
KEEP WATCH. KEEP NOTES.

SKY WATCH / AN OPEN EVENING
MAY 18, 1984
COMMUNITY MEETING ROOM
ADMISSION FREE

A public talk on distant lights, visitors in local stories, and the words people use when they describe the sky. Bring a pencil, a watch and questions.

No confirmed contact will be presented. A strange account can be discussed without accepting its explanation.

FIELD NOTE
Observe from a public place with permission. Do not climb towers, enter fenced sites, touch electrical equipment or shine lights at aircraft. Log time and direction. Compare observations with stars and aircraft before naming a cause.
key_checks: May 18, 1984; fictional local public lecture and stencil-copy appearance.
No confirmed contact will be presented; discussion is not an established finding.
Retain the safety and observation footer, including no entry into fenced sites or contact with electrical equipment.
No real Unarius name, lecturer portrait, institutional seal, branding or borrowed lecture footage.
This flyer is optional background and not Dale's Service Road / Field 01 VHS.
